description:
A powerful and easy-to-use screenshot/sticker tool that helps you improve efficiency


3.6.6.0
Settings Adjustments
- [Text Sticker] Unified the width value range for both HTML and plain text stickers.
Experience and Performance Optimizations
- [Annotation] Optimized the display effect of watermarks when switching selection areas.
Bug Fixes
- [Recording] Fixed an issue where the export progress was not displayed after minimizing the window during a standard recording.
- [Screenshot] Fixed a delay in response after triggering a screenshot on some devices when the screenshot mode is set to “Auto (Performance)”.
- [Hotkeys] Fixed an issue with mouse wheel responsiveness in the built-in hotkey settings interface.
3.6.5.1
New Features
- [Document Recognition] Added document recognition, which can convert images into documents and export them as PDF, Markdown, Word, or LaTeX; the shortcut is Shift+E.
- [Table Recognition] Added CSV format to the save options.
- [Formula Recognition] Supports adjusting font size.
- [Global Cursor] Added formula recognition functionality.
- [Annotation] Added a wavy line style for polylines.
- [Annotation] Text annotations now support right-to-left languages such as Persian and Arabic.
- [Tray Menu] Added a “Move to Group” option.
- [Save] Added TIFF format for image saving.
Settings Adjustments
- [Annotation] In “Settings” → “Annotation,” added the option “Remember Toolbar Tool Selection,” which is unchecked by default. When unchecked, selecting a secondary menu item for an annotation tool will keep that tool in the secondary menu the next time you annotate.
- [Sticker] In “Settings” → “Sticker,” added the option “Adjust Sticker to Ensure Visibility.”
- [Window Sticker] Added the option “Hide Original Window,” which is unchecked by default; this allows the browser to refresh normally even when it is partially covered.
- [Element Detection] Padding values can now be negative, with a minimum of -50.
- [Screenshot] In “Settings” → “Screenshot,” the “Left-Click Double-Click Action” and “Middle-Click Single-Click Action” now include the option “Close Screenshot.”
- [Save/Copy] Renamed “Save Image Quality” to “Save/Copy Image Quality.”
Experience and Performance Optimizations
- [Text/Formula/Table Recognition/Translation] Redesigned the dialog boxes.
- [Sticker] Holding Ctrl while left-clicking to select other stickers will also select the sticker currently in focus.
- [Screenshot] Hotkey hints during screenshots now automatically avoid the mouse cursor.
- [Annotation] Watermark annotations are always rendered at the highest layer to prevent them from being affected by mosaics or erasers.
- [Long Screenshot] Adjusted the built-in hotkeys.
Bug Fixes
- [Sticker] Fixed an issue where some options in the right-click menu would appear outside the screen under certain conditions.
- [Recording] Fixed a memory leak issue in standard recordings.
- [Quick Recording] Fixed an issue where a prompt to resume recording would still appear after restarting the computer following a normal export.
- [Hotkeys] Fixed an issue where pressing a hotkey containing Caps Lock would toggle the input method’s case.
- [Floating Ball] Fixed an issue on macOS where the “Hide During Screenshot” setting did not take effect.
- [Screenshot] Fixed a display issue with the custom screenshot management preset list on macOS.
- [Account] Fixed an issue where some devices would automatically log out.
source: Shenzhen Shendu Tujing Technology Co., Ltd.
